archetype: Archetype 5 (Jewel & Luxury) + Tech Dashboard - 'Academic Dark Glass'

typography.instructions: BANNED LIST obeyed: Syne replaced with Outfit for headings. Headings must have tracking-tighter/tracking-tight. Overlines must use font-mono, be uppercase and tracking-[0.2em]. Line height tight for headers, loose for body.

surface_styles.glassmorphism: The 'Crystal' Variant. Background: bg-[#111827]/60, Blur: backdrop-blur-xl or backdrop-blur-2xl, Border: 1px delicate inner stroke border-white/10. Shadow: shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.12)]. Use this for dashboard cards, sticky headers, and sidebars.
surface_styles.flat_solid: Use pure flat #111827 with 1px border-white/5 for deep background elements that don't need refraction.
surface_styles.tracing_beam: For pricing/upgrade/premium cards, use a shimmering gradient border (or motion.div tracing border).
surface_styles.buttons: CTAs use #6366f1 or gradient-to-r from-#6366f1 to-#22d3ee but subtle, text-white. Hover state: lighter hue or glow shadow. Secondary buttons: bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 text-white border border-white/10.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: p-1, p-2, p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12, p-16. Containers with borders MUST have internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision.
layout_and_spacing.grid_bento: MODE B: THE CONTROL ROOM GRID for dashboards. Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Tight gap (gap-4 or gap-6). Use h-full on children. No jagged bottoms.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Optical alignment over geometrical. Center headings only if needed; everything else left-aligned for data clarity.
layout_and_spacing.general: Start with grid-cols-1 (Mobile First). Ensure the header has a background (glassmorphism) and z-50.

shadcn.usage: Use heavily customized Shadcn components for advanced interactions (Tabs, Dropdowns, Dialogs, Select, Calendar, Charts).
shadcn.styling: Strip default 'Vercel-look'. Override radii to max 8px (rounded-lg) or even 12px (rounded-xl) for organic glass feel. Use the glassmorphism surface_styles.
shadcn.charts: Use Recharts (Shadcn chart component). Dark mode tooltips with border-white/10. Colors: indigo, cyan, emerald.
shadcn.calendars: Use Shadcn calendar, style active days with #6366f1, completely transparent background. Keep dark mode theme.
shadcn.inputs: bg-black/20 border-white/10 text-white placeholder:text-white/30 focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-[#6366f1]

custom.gamification: Podium, XP bars, streak flames should be built with raw Tailwind + Framer Motion. Use vivid accents (success, warning) on dark bg.
custom.prepmeter_radar: Recharts Radar Chart with cyan and indigo fill, stroke-white/20, transparent background.
custom.kanban: Todo list columns should be semi-transparent containers (bg-white/5), tasks are glass cards (bg-white/10).

motion_and_interactions.engine: Framer Motion (mandatory for grid entry and gamification events).
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements must have hover states. E.g. hover:bg-white/10 hover:text-white. Hover color must be lighter hue.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out. Do not use generic 'transition: all' in pure CSS, use Tailwind specific 'transition-colors' or 'transition-transform'.

icons_and_assets.icons_library: @phosphor-icons/react (Weight: duotone or regular) to match the high-end dashboard feel. DO NOT USE generic FontAwesome.

testing.attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include `data-testid` attribute. Applies to: buttons, links, form inputs, menus, error messages, user balances, confirmation text. Convention: kebab-case, role-based.

instructions_to_main_agent: Always use the media URLs provided in this JSON. NEVER use placeholder URLs like via.placeholder.com.
Ensure glassmorphism is achieved using `bg-[#111827]/60 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10`. Do not use pure opaque colors for cards.
Ensure dark mode is the default and only mode.
Add 'dark' class to html/body or use a ThemeProvider.
Use Outfit for Headings, DM Sans for Body, and JetBrains Mono for code/numbers/XP tracking.

For the gamification elements (podium, leaderboard, XP), use gradients `bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-500 to-cyan-400` sparingly, applying them mostly to text `bg-clip-text text-transparent` or progress bars.
For the AI Chatbot Drawer, use Shadcn Sheet with glass styling.
For the PrepMeter Radar, use Recharts RadarChart component with transparent background.
Adhere to `data-testid` requirements for all interactive elements.
Add 'grain' or 'noise' overlay to the main app layout background using a subtle CSS radial-gradient or SVG noise pattern.
